name: fix75_chest_approach
verifies: fix-75 #4/#5: using a chest from 3 m the hero walks to it (G3 PS_Interact -> _AI_Goto_Ext), faces it, kneels and opens it, then the loot page opens; the secondary button cancels the approach and ends a seat (G3 action 0x66 -> PS_Interact_End): he stands up, the slot is free, no block
notes: useprobe logs the metres walked in the approach and what was placed at once (stuck at the object's collider). cancel = the secondary button (HeroObjectUse.RequestCancel, the same path as a press of Use2). cancel fails when the hero still holds the object's slot (StationClaims) or the block went up.
